name: tempered-marketplace
description: Tempered Works plugins for Claude Code: interface mods (limit-resume, ship-state, timeline, followups, lessons, focus-group) and skill packs (tempered-skills, multi-harness).

plugins.name: limit-resume
plugins.description: Auto-resumes a turn killed by a rate limit or API error once the limit resets; shows 5h/7d usage and warns at 85%.

plugins.name: ship-state
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: branch, dirty files, ahead/behind, PR, CI and prod deploy for the repo the session works in; toasts when CI finishes or prod goes live; one-key commit/push button.

plugins.name: timeline
plugins.description: Vertical orchestration timeline: talk on the left, work milestones with progress and live subagent cards on the right, per repo across sessions.

plugins.name: followups
plugins.description: After each answer, 4 next-prompt options above the prompt box (keys 1-4); picking one fills the box. Replaces the single grey suggestion.

plugins.name: lessons
plugins.description: Spots wins and pitfalls in your prompts and has Claude run your win-logger / pitfall-logger skills; session tally in the status line.

plugins.name: focus-group
plugins.description: Side pane for a self-staffing-focus-group run: roster, gates G0-G5, findings. Runs reviewers and verifiers in the foreground and refuses a G4/G5 pass while an agent still runs.

plugins.name: tempered-skills
plugins.description: 25 skills for prompt writing, verification, shipping discipline, drift audits and Supabase safety.

plugins.name: multi-harness
plugins.description: 6 skills to plan large work in waves and track it to completion: wave planning, agent patterns, branch and PR closeout, tracker sync, QA evidence, safety review.
